findings: N1 establishes a sharper stationary local connected-correlation comparison at fixed physical scales and fixed support, including gamma<3 windows; it does not settle actual unshortened endpoint dynamics.

N2 establishes the exact complete 24L^3-link incidence budget and joint support/time certificate. The beta=0 floor and origin geometry are essential; necessity is for the nonnegative certificate, not actual nonconvergence.

O1 proves a simultaneous all-order volume-uniform weighted remainder and common operator-domain control while retaining D. A small uncentered remainder and scalar adjustment alone do not close numerical stability.

O2 proves an all-step obstruction for the stated positive-budget bare-reference recurrences: positive retained D is repeatedly divided by a summable loss tending to zero. This is not failure of the actual algorithm, every alternative inverse, or the physical homogeneous gap.

O2 structured same-weight controls do not establish occurrence on the actual SU2 trajectory. Its admitted post-freeze support clarification distinguishes regrouped actual-support and indexed pair-union constants.

P1 rejects the actual thirty-fixed-link section even in the electric graph topology, and rejects its F9-fitted clock on reserved F16 data. Pointwise section values do not identify physical Hilbert maps.

P2 repairs the map with an onto Haar unitary and a selected reducing electric isometry with H1/H2 and graph-domain closure. All tree and mixed derivatives are retained; the x,y,z completions have lengths6,8,6 and differ from P1 faces.

P2 fits c=6alpha from the newly mapped x slope, leaves zeta free until reserved curvature forces zero, and then rejects the conditional family on the full y curve. Exact physical/effective reduction and conditional-family mismatch are compatible conclusions.

No accepted result transfers among the canonical summable, homogeneous or finite electric models by notation. No measured physical calibration, interacting reduction or continuum mass-gap theorem has been established.

The highest-ranked next directions address the actual magnetic closure of P2 and the actual retained diagonal obstructing O2. Canonical endpoint dynamics remains a strong but less immediately bounded alternative.
